h1.en: Diesel 120 vs LZ-80 Concrete Pump: 290 kW beside the Four-stroke engine article
h1.zh: 柴油120和LZ-80混凝土泵有何不同：对照「四冲程循环」时，290 kW仍在原页

directAnswer.en: Diesel 120 and LZ-80 are high-output diesel concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Diesel 120 lists 290 kW as two 145 kW units, 100 m³/h, 40 MPa and distance 150 m / 500 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Four-stroke_engine.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油120和 LZ-80 是河北品锦机械在邢台的大排量柴油混凝土泵。柴油120标出 290 kW（两台 145 kW）、100 m³/h、40 MPa、距离 150 m / 500 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Four-stroke_engine。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Four-stroke_engine. The picture shows Four-stroke engine. Diesel 120 and LZ-80 are high-output diesel concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Theoretical output: Diesel 120 lists 100 m³/h. LZ-80 lists High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h. low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Four-stroke_engine。画面是Four-stroke engine。柴油120和 LZ-80 是河北品锦机械在邢台的大排量柴油混凝土泵。理论输送量：柴油120标出 100 m³/h；LZ-80标出 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看柴油120请打开 /zh/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/，看LZ-80请打开 /zh/products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Diesel 120 lists 290 kW as two 145 kW units, 100 m³/h, 40 MPa and distance 150 m / 500 m. Hydraulic pump: Diesel 120 lists Kawasaki 112 (two units). LZ-80 lists Kawasaki double 140. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Two large diesel rows still use different output notation: one figure versus a high and low ceiling. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 柴油120标出 290 kW（两台 145 kW）、100 m³/h、40 MPa、距离 150 m / 500 m。液压泵：柴油120标出 Kawasaki 112 (two units)；LZ-80标出 Kawasaki double 140。柴油120有、LZ-80没有的行：柴油机功率 290 kW (two units 145 kW)；最大出口压力 40 MPa；输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 500 m；整机重量 8000 kg。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: LZ-80 lists 256 kW (Yuchai), high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h at ≤ 35 MPa, and low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h at ≤ 22 MPa. Dimensions: Diesel 120 lists 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. LZ-80 lists 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Diesel 120 lists entries that LZ-80 does not: Diesel engine power 290 kW (two units 145 kW). Max. outlet pressure 40 MPa. Conveying distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m. Main unit weight 8000 kg. Open /en/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 120 and /en/products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump/ for LZ-80.
body.zh: LZ-80 标出 256 kW（玉柴），高压 ≤ 65 m³/h、≤ 35 MPa，低压 ≤ 95 m³/h、≤ 22 MPa。外形尺寸：柴油120标出 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm；LZ-80标出 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。LZ-80有、柴油120没有的行：柴油发动机 256 kW (Yuchai)；泵送压力 High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa；输送距离 120 m；输送高度 Consult factory standard；整机重量 6800 kg。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: Both list aggregate 6 cm and below and a 0.6 m³ hopper. The same shown value on a shared label: Hopper capacity is 0.6 m³ on both pages. Max. aggregate size is 6 cm and below on both pages. LZ-80 lists entries that Diesel 120 does not: Engine (diesel) 256 kW (Yuchai). Pumping pressure High pressure ≤ 35 MPa. low pressure ≤ 22 MPa. Conveying distance 120 m. Delivery height Consult factory standard. Total weight 6800 kg. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 骨料都是 6 cm 及以下，料斗都是 0.6 m³。同一标题下数值相同的有：料斗容积两边都是 0.6 m³；最大骨料粒径两边都是 6 cm and below。两台大型柴油泵的产量写法仍不同：一个数字，对上一高一低两档上限。

question.en: Does Diesel 120 list the same theoretical output as LZ-80?
question.zh: 柴油120和LZ-80的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 120 lists 100 m³/h. LZ-80 lists High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h. low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Four-stroke_engine.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油120标出 100 m³/h。LZ-80标出 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Four-stroke_engine画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 120 list the same hydraulic pump as LZ-80?
question.zh: 柴油120和LZ-80的液压泵一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 120 lists Kawasaki 112 (two units). LZ-80 lists Kawasaki double 140. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Four-stroke_engine.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油120标出 Kawasaki 112 (two units)。LZ-80标出 Kawasaki double 140。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Four-stroke_engine画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 120 list the same dimensions as LZ-80?
question.zh: 柴油120和LZ-80的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 120 lists 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. LZ-80 lists 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Four-stroke_engine.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油120标出 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm。LZ-80标出 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Four-stroke_engine画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is diesel engine power missing on LZ-80?
question.zh: 为什么LZ-80没有柴油机功率？

answer.en: The LZ-80 page does not list that label. Diesel 120 lists 290 kW (two units 145 kW). Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Four-stroke_engine.
answer.zh: LZ-80这一页没有标出这个标题。柴油120标出的是 290 kW (two units 145 kW)。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Four-stroke_engine画面里印出的数字。
